They took many photos at the city library. Nina wants to be a cook in the future. The weather was sunny that day. The brick facade dates from 1820.
David is interested in reading. Nina hopes to visit Toronto one day. Nina drinks tea after doing sports. A holiday by the sea is a real luxury.
